display.title: Local Economy
display.subtitle: Trade with a villager
description: Villagers trade emeralds for everyday goods: food, building blocks, light, iron tools and armor, and XP bottles from a journeyman cleric on.
No villager sells enchanted books or diamond gear. Enchant at the table, or buy books from the Relic Broker.
Find a village, locate a villager with a profession, and complete one trade.
